error.headline: [REQ AC-6] GET /rest/basket/{id} for B's basket with A's token does not return B's basket

entries.failingStep: And the request for B's basket does not return B's basket

auto.next: Confirm live in the AUT (replay with api-probe.ts, observe the actual value), then record with --set.

final.title: A customer can read another customer's basket
final.rationale: AC-6: a request authenticated as A for B's basket must be refused and must not return B's basket. Live: A's token on B's basket id answers 200 with B's basket (its UserId is B's).

error.headline: [REQ AC-6] GET /rest/basket/{id} for B's basket with A's token is refused (not 2xx)

entries.failingStep: Then the request is refused with a non-2xx status

signals: SCN-008 rests on an unsettled reading (assumed G4). Confirm what the application does as usual; the verdict then lists it as a question for the owner, not as a defect.
auto.next: Confirm live in the AUT (replay with api-probe.ts, observe the actual value), then record with --set.

final.title: A customer can read another customer's basket
final.rationale: Same root cause as SCN-007: the request is not refused (200).
